name: Penalty too large
lesson: A very large penalty makes every overweight bag worthless, so the search cannot use the edge between bags that fit and bags that do not, and fewer runs find the optimum.
lookFor: With ρ = 50 and this seed the best bag that fits after 100 generations is worth 116, not the optimum 123, and 6 of the 8 bags in the final population fit. The same seed finds 123 in generation 33 with ρ = 8 and in generation 13 with ρ = 3. Over seeds 1 to 100, 58 runs find 123 within 100 generations with ρ = 50 and 86 with ρ = 3; every one of the 100 runs with ρ = 50 still ends with a bag worth at least 112, so a penalty that is too large slows the search down but does not stop it.
